name: Yuzuki Kei
source:
She is tall and has good facial features, and you might be tempted to call her “big sis"!

She is charitable and smiles kindly to everyone, so she is often confessed to by girls.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/saimin_wonderful/character_i.html#character_i]official website[/url]]
